title: Vibe Coding in Software Development: A Multivocal Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2607.21652v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vibe coding is an AI-assisted software development approach in which developers express intent in natural language and large language models generate code. To our knowledge, no review has synthesized academic and practitioner sources under a common protocol. We conducted a multivocal literature review of publications from January 2022 to 9 September 2026, identified through searches in October 2025 and September 2026. After assessing source quality and credibility, we analyzed 266 sources (76 peer-reviewed, 190 grey) across eight research questions: 146 were direct, 93 adjacent, and 27 background. Presence and outcome findings receive reporting-support and evidence-strength labels, respectively. The second author conducted twelve checks; pre-reconciliation agreement was low in several, but substantial for the final directness rule and moderate for the outcome fields, which were checked in full. translated_title: 软件开发中的氛围编程：一项多声部文献综述
translated_abstract: 氛围编程是一种AI辅助的软件开发方法，开发人员以自然语言表达意图，由大型语言模型生成代码。据我们所知，目前尚无综述在统一协议下对学术文献与从业者来源进行综合。我们对2022年1月至2026年9月9日的出版物开展了多声部文献综述，文献通过2025年10月和2026年9月的检索确定。在评估来源质量与可信度后，我们围绕八个研究问题分析了266个来源（76个同行评审文献、190个灰色文献）：其中146个为直接相关，93个为相邻相关，27个为背景资料。存在性发现与结果性发现分别被赋予报告支持标签和证据强度标签。第二作者进行了十二次核对；其中部分核对在调和前的一致性较低，但最终直接性判定规则的一致性较高，而结果字段的一致性为中等，这些字段均经过完整核对。文献来源描述了一种生成-评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 这是首个在统一协议下对“氛围编程”进行的多声部文献综述，综合分析了266个学术与从业者来源（76个同行评审、190个灰色文献），围绕八个研究问题系统梳理了这一AI辅助开发方法的现有证据。
en_tdlr: This is the first multivocal literature review on vibe coding under a common protocol, synthesizing 266 academic and practitioner sources (76 peer-reviewed, 190 grey) across eight research questions to map the existing evidence on this AI-assisted development approach.
